summary: Iteration 42 frontend-only testing. ProviderExplainer works fully as specified (all data-testids, scene switching, pause behavior, CTA nav all PASS). Marketplace 'Sell an item' flow has a URL-persistence bug: navigating to /marketplace/new (via landing tile or deep link) opens the listing dialog correctly, BUT the URL is immediately rewritten to /marketplace on mount before the user can dismiss. Regression tests all PASS (dialog does NOT auto-open on /marketplace, marketplace-create button still opens dialog, filters work).

integration_issues.issue: URL is rewritten from /marketplace/new to /marketplace on mount BEFORE the user closes the dialog. Both useEffects in Marketplace.jsx run on mount; the second effect fires while openCreate is still `false` (initial state) and calls navigate('/marketplace', {replace:true}). Dialog still opens (setOpenCreate(true) also fires), but the intended contract 'URL stays /marketplace/new while dialog is open, rewrites to /marketplace on dismiss' is broken. Test spec explicitly says: 'you should land on /marketplace/new AND the New listing dialog should be open automatically' — the second half passes, the first half fails.

critical_code_review_comments: Marketplace.jsx: The two useEffects that couple `openCreate` with `location.pathname` fight each other on mount (see integration_issues above). Guard the redirect effect with a ref-tracked 'was previously open' flag.
ProviderExplainer.jsx: overall code is clean. Minor: the progress bar interval fires every 100ms even when the user has switched tabs — consider clearing on visibilitychange. Not blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 89% (8 of 9 acceptance criteria pass; the /marketplace/new URL-persistence check fails)

context_for_next_testing_agent: ProviderExplainer is fully verified — no need to retest scene-switching, pause, CTA. Focus retest on Marketplace.jsx URL persistence after the useRef fix: (1) direct nav to /marketplace/new should keep URL /marketplace/new until dialog is closed, then rewrite to /marketplace; (2) landing 'Sell an item' tile click should also keep URL /marketplace/new until dismissed; (3) regression: /marketplace no auto-open, marketplace-create button still opens dialog.

rca of the issue.bug: URL /marketplace/new immediately rewrites to /marketplace on mount
reproduction_steps: 1. Navigate directly to https://<host>/marketplace/new (or click 'Sell an item' tile from landing)
2. Observe: listing dialog opens (good), BUT window.location.pathname is already '/marketplace' (bad)
3. Expected per spec: pathname should remain '/marketplace/new' until user dismisses the dialog, then rewrite to '/marketplace'
rca of the issue.root_cause: In Marketplace.jsx, two useEffects both run on initial mount. Effect A (line 38, dep=[location.pathname]) sees pathname='/marketplace/new' and schedules setOpenCreate(true). Effect B (line 46, dep=[openCreate]) also runs on mount — with the INITIAL value of openCreate (false) — so its guard `!openCreate && pathname === '/marketplace/new'` evaluates true and it calls navigate('/marketplace', {replace:true}). React batches the state updates so both fire before the next render, and the URL rewrite wins the race.
rca of the issue.mitigation: Add a useRef to track whether the dialog has ever been open, and only trigger the URL rewrite on the true open→closed transition (not on initial mount). See action_items for a code snippet.
